hook.en: You knock three times at a friend's door and no one answers. Islam has already told you what to do: go home politely and come back later.
hook.bm: Anda mengetuk pintu rumah kawan tiga kali dan tiada jawapan. Islam sudah memberitahu apa yang perlu dilakukan: pulang dengan sopan dan datang semula kemudian.

bigIdeas.en: Honouring neighbours is a sign of faith (al-Bukhari and Muslim).
bigIdeas.bm: Memuliakan jiran ialah tanda iman (al-Bukhari dan Muslim).

bigIdeas.en: Ask permission and give salam before entering another's house (an-Nur: 27); if not allowed after three times, return.
bigIdeas.bm: Minta izin dan beri salam sebelum memasuki rumah orang lain (an-Nur: 27); jika tidak diizinkan selepas tiga kali, pulang.

bigIdeas.en: Humans are khalifah who must not cause damage on earth (al-A'raf: 56).
bigIdeas.bm: Manusia ialah khalifah yang tidak boleh melakukan kerosakan di muka bumi (al-A'raf: 56).

detail.en: Greet, share food, help, do not disturb
detail.bm: Beri salam, berkongsi makanan, membantu, tidak mengganggu

detail.en: Salam, up to three times, stand to the side, accept "no"
detail.bm: Salam, hingga tiga kali, berdiri di tepi pintu, terima jika ditolak

detail.en: Do not pollute, save water, plant trees
detail.bm: Jangan mencemar, jimat air, tanam pokok

detail.en: Humans are trustees of the earth

definition.en: People living near us, Muslim or not.
definition.bm: Orang yang tinggal berhampiran kita, Muslim atau bukan.

definition.en: A trustee or vicegerent appointed to look after the earth.
definition.bm: Pemegang amanah yang dilantik untuk mentadbir bumi.

definition.en: Parts of the body that must be covered; one reason to ask permission before entering.
definition.bm: Bahagian tubuh yang wajib ditutup; salah satu sebab perlu meminta izin sebelum masuk.

question.en: Your neighbour is non-Muslim and is ill. What should you do?
question.bm: Jiran anda bukan Islam dan sedang sakit. Apakah yang patut anda lakukan?

steps.en: Islam commands kindness to all neighbours (an-Nisa': 36).
steps.bm: Islam memerintahkan berbuat baik kepada semua jiran (an-Nisa': 36).

steps.en: Visit them, offer help or food, and keep noise down.
steps.bm: Ziarahi mereka, tawarkan bantuan atau makanan, dan kurangkan bunyi bising.

answer.en: Show kindness and help — it is part of faith.
answer.bm: Tunjukkan kebaikan dan bantuan — ia sebahagian daripada iman.

prompt.en: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honour his ___." Fill in the blank.
prompt.bm: "Sesiapa yang beriman kepada Allah dan hari akhirat, hendaklah dia memuliakan ___." Isikan tempat kosong.

explanation.en: Narrated by al-Bukhari and Muslim.
explanation.bm: Riwayat al-Bukhari dan Muslim.

prompt.en: Select ALL good manners towards neighbours.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA adab yang baik terhadap jiran.

explanation.en: Blocking a neighbour's gate hurts them.
explanation.bm: Menghalang pagar jiran menyakiti mereka.

options.en: Not making loud noise at night
options.bm: Tidak membuat bising pada waktu malam

options.en: Parking in front of their gate
options.bm: Meletak kenderaan di hadapan pagar mereka

prompt.en: Islam commands us to be kind to…
prompt.bm: Islam memerintahkan kita berbuat baik kepada…

explanation.en: An-Nisa': 36 mentions both near and distant neighbours.
explanation.bm: An-Nisa': 36 menyebut jiran dekat dan jiran jauh.

options.bm: semua jiran, Muslim dan bukan Muslim

prompt.en: Which surah and verse teaches asking permission and giving salam before entering others' houses?
prompt.bm: Surah dan ayat manakah mengajar meminta izin dan memberi salam sebelum memasuki rumah orang lain?

explanation.en: Surah an-Nur contains many social rules.
explanation.bm: Surah an-Nur mengandungi banyak peraturan sosial.

prompt.en: Permission to enter should be asked at most ______ times; if there is no answer, return.
prompt.bm: Izin untuk masuk sebaiknya diminta paling banyak ______ kali; jika tiada jawapan, pulang.

explanation.en: Narrated by al-Bukhari and Muslim.
explanation.bm: Riwayat al-Bukhari dan Muslim.

prompt.en: Where should you stand when knocking at a door?
prompt.bm: Di manakah anda patut berdiri semasa mengetuk pintu?

explanation.en: This protects the privacy and aurat of the people inside.
explanation.bm: Ini menjaga privasi dan aurat penghuni.

options.en: To the side of the door, not facing straight in
options.bm: Di tepi pintu, tidak menghadap terus ke dalam
Betul-betul di hadapan sambil menjenguk ke dalam

prompt.en: Humans are appointed on earth as…
prompt.bm: Manusia dilantik di bumi sebagai…

explanation.en: Al-Baqarah: 30.
explanation.bm: Al-Baqarah: 30.

options.bm: pemilik yang boleh berbuat sesuka hati

prompt.en: "Do not cause corruption on the earth after it has been set right" is from…
prompt.bm: "Janganlah kamu membuat kerosakan di muka bumi selepas Allah memperbaikinya" ialah daripada…

explanation.en: Also see ar-Rum: 41.
explanation.bm: Lihat juga ar-Rum: 41.

prompt.en: Arrange the manners of visiting a house.
prompt.bm: Susun adab menziarahi rumah.

explanation.en: If told to go back, go back — it is purer for you (an-Nur: 28).
explanation.bm: Jika disuruh pulang, pulanglah — itu lebih suci bagimu (an-Nur: 28).

items.en: Wait; repeat up to three times

items.bm: Pulang dengan sopan jika tidak diizinkan

prompt.en: Why must children ask permission before entering their parents' room at certain times?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah anak-anak perlu meminta izin sebelum memasuki bilik ibu bapa pada waktu tertentu?

explanation.en: The three times: before Subuh, midday rest and after Isyak.
explanation.bm: Tiga waktu: sebelum Subuh, waktu rehat tengah hari dan selepas Isyak.

options.en: To respect privacy and protect aurat (an-Nur: 58)
options.bm: Untuk menghormati privasi dan menjaga aurat (an-Nur: 58)

prompt.en: Match each situation with the correct action.
prompt.bm: Padankan situasi dengan tindakan yang betul.

explanation.en: Small kindnesses build a caring community.
explanation.bm: Kebaikan kecil membina masyarakat penyayang.

right.en: Keep an eye on their house

prompt.en: What happens to a person whose neighbour is not safe from his harm, according to hadith?
prompt.bm: Apakah kedudukan orang yang jirannya tidak selamat daripada kejahatannya, menurut hadis?

explanation.en: The Prophet ﷺ warned strongly against harming neighbours (al-Bukhari).
explanation.bm: Rasulullah ﷺ memberi amaran keras terhadap menyakiti jiran (al-Bukhari).

prompt.en: Select ALL actions that show good adab towards the environment.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA tindakan yang menunjukkan adab yang baik terhadap alam sekitar.

explanation.en: Open burning pollutes the air.
explanation.bm: Pembakaran terbuka mencemarkan udara.

prompt.en: "Corruption has appeared on land and sea because of what people's hands have earned" is…
prompt.bm: "Telah timbul kerosakan di darat dan di laut disebabkan perbuatan tangan manusia" ialah…

explanation.en: It reminds us that pollution has human causes.
explanation.bm: Ia mengingatkan bahawa pencemaran berpunca daripada manusia.

prompt.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught us not to waste water even when taking ______ at a flowing river.
prompt.bm: Rasulullah ﷺ mengajar supaya tidak membazir air walaupun ketika mengambil ______ di sungai yang mengalir.

explanation.en: Narrated by Ibn Majah.
explanation.bm: Riwayat Ibn Majah.

prompt.en: A student opens a classmate's bag without asking. Which adab is broken?
prompt.bm: Seorang murid membuka beg rakan tanpa bertanya. Adab manakah yang dilanggar?

explanation.en: The principle of asking permission applies to belongings, phones and messages too.
explanation.bm: Prinsip meminta izin juga terpakai pada barang, telefon dan mesej.

options.en: Asking permission (respecting others' property and privacy)
options.bm: Meminta izin (menghormati harta dan privasi orang lain)

prompt.en: A neighbour often plays loud music late at night. What is the BEST Islamic response?
prompt.bm: Seorang jiran kerap memasang muzik kuat lewat malam. Apakah tindakan PALING baik menurut Islam?

explanation.en: Good advice is given gently; escalate to the residents' committee only if needed.
explanation.bm: Nasihat diberi dengan lembut; rujuk jawatankuasa penduduk hanya jika perlu.

options.en: Speak to him politely and privately first, and stay kind
options.bm: Bercakap dengannya secara sopan dan bersendirian terlebih dahulu, serta terus berbuat baik

options.en: Shout at him from the window

prompt.en: How does the rule of asking permission apply in the digital age?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah adab meminta izin terpakai dalam era digital?

explanation.en: The aim — privacy and dignity — is the same.
explanation.bm: Tujuannya — privasi dan maruah — tetap sama.

options.en: Ask before sharing someone's photo or using their account
options.bm: Minta izin sebelum berkongsi gambar seseorang atau menggunakan akaunnya

options.en: Anything online is free to use
options.bm: Apa sahaja dalam talian bebas digunakan

prompt.en: Why is protecting the environment part of being a good Muslim?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah memelihara alam sekitar sebahagian daripada menjadi Muslim yang baik?

explanation.en: Khalifah means responsibility, not ownership.
explanation.bm: Khalifah bermaksud tanggungjawab, bukan pemilikan.

options.en: The earth is an amanah from Allah, and damaging it harms other creatures and future generations
options.bm: Bumi ialah amanah Allah, dan merosakkannya memudaratkan makhluk lain serta generasi akan datang

options.en: It is only the government's job
It has no link to religion

prompt.en: A factory releases waste into a river used by villagers. Based on al-A'raf: 56, this is…
prompt.bm: Sebuah kilang melepaskan sisa ke sungai yang digunakan penduduk kampung. Berdasarkan al-A'raf: 56, ini ialah…

explanation.en: Harm to others and to nature is not allowed.
explanation.bm: Memudaratkan orang lain dan alam tidak dibenarkan.

options.en: causing corruption (fasad) on earth, which is forbidden
options.bm: membuat kerosakan (fasad) di bumi, yang dilarang
